risks.note: MD&A Risks & Concerns states volatility in the prices of key raw materials, including polyester staple fiber, viscose staple fiber and other inputs, may impact operating margins and profitability. As a single-product spinner with no vertical integration disclosed, input prices flow straight through to spreads.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility - polyester staple fibre, viscose staple fibre and other inputs

risks.note: The MD&A explicitly names fluctuations in energy costs, particularly natural gas and electricity, as a driver of operating margins. Spinning is energy-intensive; the 2.72 MW captive solar plant covers only part of the load.
risks.risk: Energy cost volatility - natural gas and electricity

risks.note: MD&A states the textile industry faces intense competition from both domestic manufacturers and overseas suppliers, and the Outlook flags low cost imports and a sluggish domestic market as continuing challenges. This limits pricing power in a commoditised yarn market.
risks.risk: Intense competition from domestic manufacturers, overseas suppliers and low-cost imports

risks.note: The Board's Report states the industry witnessed subdued demand due to geopolitical uncertainties, economic slowdown and weak demand in key markets such as Europe, Turkey, the United States and the United Kingdom, which resulted in increased supply in the domestic market, exerting pressure on pricing and margins.
risks.risk: Weak global demand redirecting supply into the domestic market and compressing prices

risks.note: The Company operates in a single business segment - manufacturing and selling of man-made fiber yarn - and undertook no export activity during FY2025-26, so there is no product or geographic diversification to offset a downturn in Indian synthetic blended yarn.

Yarn production fell approximately 11% to 174 lakh kilograms, which the Board's Report attributes to subdued market demand and man power shortage; the MD&A Opportunities & Threats section also lists labour shortages as an industry risk. Under-utilisation of a fixed-cost spinning asset base directly hurts profitability.

MD&A cites evolving environmental and sustainability standards, stringent environmental and sustainability regulations, and regulatory developments as factors that may affect market conditions and business operations. The Board's Report also notes an exceptional employee-benefits charge arising from proposed new labour laws.

MD&A states inflationary pressures, supply chain disruptions and fluctuations in foreign exchange rates may have an indirect impact on the Company's business, and changing customer preferences and geopolitical uncertainty may affect market conditions.
risks.risk: Macro pass-through risks - inflation, supply chain disruption and foreign exchange
